taskcompletionsource-async-continuations.title: Keep TaskCompletionSource continuations off the completing call stack
taskcompletionsource-async-continuations.short: Avoid unexpectedly running arbitrary await continuations inline
taskcompletionsource-async-continuations.summary: TaskCompletionSource can complete a Task from callback-style code, and RunContinuationsAsynchronously separates completion from continuation execution.
taskcompletionsource-async-continuations.why: Inline continuations can execute user code while locks are held or on a sensitive callback thread, creating reentrancy and latency surprises.
taskcompletionsource-async-continuations.tips: Prefer RunContinuationsAsynchronously for general-purpose bridges unless inline continuation execution is explicitly required and proven safe.

channel-single-reader-writer-contract.title: Declare Channel single-reader and single-writer guarantees only when they are true
channel-single-reader-writer-contract.short: Channel options can exploit ownership guarantees for cheaper coordination
channel-single-reader-writer-contract.summary: Channel options can state that only one reader or writer will access a channel, allowing implementations to optimize synchronization.
channel-single-reader-writer-contract.why: Marking a channel single-reader or single-writer while multiple consumers actually use it violates the contract behind those optimizations.
channel-single-reader-writer-contract.tips: Enable these flags only when architecture enforces the guarantee for the channel's entire lifetime; otherwise keep the general multi-party defaults.

memorypool-owner-disposal-boundary.title: Keep IMemoryOwner alive for exactly as long as rented memory is used
memorypool-owner-disposal-boundary.short: The owner, not Memory itself, controls pooled-buffer lifetime
memorypool-owner-disposal-boundary.summary: MemoryPool returns an IMemoryOwner whose disposal returns or releases the backing storage while Memory is merely a view over it.
memorypool-owner-disposal-boundary.why: Losing or disposing the owner while another operation still holds its Memory can produce use-after-return bugs and data corruption.
memorypool-owner-disposal-boundary.tips: Pass ownership explicitly across asynchronous boundaries and dispose only after every consumer has finished with the rented region.

randomaccess-explicit-file-offset-io.title: Use RandomAccess for concurrent file I/O with explicit offsets
randomaccess-explicit-file-offset-io.short: Avoid coordinating a shared mutable stream position
randomaccess-explicit-file-offset-io.summary: RandomAccess reads and writes through a file handle at explicit offsets, which fits workloads where independent operations target different file regions.
randomaccess-explicit-file-offset-io.why: Concurrent code that mutates one FileStream Position must coordinate that shared cursor even when the actual regions are independent.
randomaccess-explicit-file-offset-io.tips: Use explicit offsets for naturally positional workloads, preserve handle lifetime, and still bound concurrency according to storage characteristics.

searchvalues-reused-character-set.title: Reuse SearchValues for repeated set-based searches
searchvalues-reused-character-set.short: Precompute a frequently reused character or byte search set
searchvalues-reused-character-set.summary: SearchValues represents a prepared set used by span search operations and can improve repeated matching of the same delimiters or character classes.
searchvalues-reused-character-set.why: Reconstructing matching state in a hot loop adds work that can be moved to initialization when the searched set is stable.
searchvalues-reused-character-set.tips: Store stable SearchValues instances for repeated searches and benchmark realistic inputs rather than assuming every small search benefits.

utf8parser-allocation-free-numeric-input.title: Parse numeric UTF-8 fields without creating intermediate strings
utf8parser-allocation-free-numeric-input.short: Utf8Parser can consume numbers directly from byte spans
utf8parser-allocation-free-numeric-input.summary: Utf8Parser parses supported primitive values from UTF-8 bytes and reports how many bytes were consumed.
utf8parser-allocation-free-numeric-input.why: Decoding a numeric field to a temporary string before parsing adds allocation and transcoding work in byte-oriented protocols.
utf8parser-allocation-free-numeric-input.tips: Validate both the parse result and consumed length when the whole field must be numeric, and keep ordinary parsing when allocation is not material.

gcmemoryinfo-pressure-signal-not-budget.title: Treat GCMemoryInfo as a runtime pressure signal, not an exact allocation budget
gcmemoryinfo-pressure-signal-not-budget.short: GC memory metrics describe runtime conditions rather than a guaranteed safe limit
gcmemoryinfo-pressure-signal-not-budget.summary: GCMemoryInfo exposes memory-load, heap, threshold, and collection information useful for diagnostics and adaptive behavior.
gcmemoryinfo-pressure-signal-not-budget.why: Turning one snapshot into a hard promise about how many bytes can safely be allocated ignores concurrent allocations and changing operating-system pressure.
gcmemoryinfo-pressure-signal-not-budget.tips: Use the values as telemetry or conservative signals, sample trends where useful, and let normal allocation failure handling remain correct.

timeprovider-timer-lifetime.title: Own and dispose timers created through TimeProvider
timeprovider-timer-lifetime.short: Injectable time does not remove timer lifetime management
timeprovider-timer-lifetime.summary: TimeProvider.CreateTimer creates an ITimer whose callbacks continue according to its schedule until the timer is changed or disposed.
timeprovider-timer-lifetime.why: Discarding the timer owner can leave callbacks active beyond the lifetime of the service they reference.
timeprovider-timer-lifetime.tips: Store the timer with the owning component, stop or dispose it during shutdown, and keep callbacks safe against concurrent disposal.

json-typeinfo-resolver-composition-order.title: Make JSON type-info resolver composition order deliberate
json-typeinfo-resolver-composition-order.short: The first resolver that supplies metadata can determine serialization behavior
json-typeinfo-resolver-composition-order.summary: System.Text.Json can compose generated and custom metadata resolvers so different model groups or policies share one options instance.
json-typeinfo-resolver-composition-order.why: Adding resolvers without considering precedence can cause a fallback resolver to win before the intended generated or customized metadata is consulted.
json-typeinfo-resolver-composition-order.tips: Order resolvers from specific policy to general fallback and cover representative model types with serialization tests.

frozendictionary-readmostly-construction.title: Build FrozenDictionary at the read-mostly boundary
frozendictionary-readmostly-construction.short: Pay construction cost once when keys become stable
frozendictionary-readmostly-construction.summary: FrozenDictionary is optimized for lookup after construction and suits data that is built or loaded once and then queried repeatedly.
frozendictionary-readmostly-construction.why: Rebuilding a frozen collection for frequently changing data can cost more than using a mutable dictionary whose update pattern matches the workload.
frozendictionary-readmostly-construction.tips: Freeze only after the key set stabilizes, choose the intended comparer at construction, and measure startup versus steady-state lookup tradeoffs.
